reason: The official Ashford Borough Council Planning Public Register help page is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from a static planning notice to the council's application-document retrieval workflow. It verifies that the public register supports reference-based search and that application documents can be viewed from the associated application's Files section, but this source window contains no PA/2024/1920 target-specific plan geometry itself. No parcel geometry is inferred from the availability of documents; spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
